description: Generates a full Tailwind CSS palette (50-950) from one color, ready to paste. Call it whenever you add a color to a Tailwind theme (e.g. "add a brand color #db4d53"), instead of writing a single variable or inventing shades. The input color stays exactly at its best-fit shade, and the other shades follow the closest Tailwind color, so they look like Tailwind's own.

color.description: Any CSS color: hex (#db4d53), rgb(), hsl(), oklch() or a named color

format.description: Color format. Defaults to oklch for v4 and hex for older versions

name.description: Color name used in the code, e.g. "brand". Defaults to the closest Tailwind color, which replaces Tailwind's own palette of that name (e.g. red), so pass a name unless that is what the user wants

output.description: theme: a v4 @theme block for the main CSS file. config: an object for theme.extend.colors in tailwind.config.js. css: plain CSS variables. Defaults to theme for v4 and config for older versions

tailwindVersion.description: The project's Tailwind CSS major version. Defaults to 4

name: generate_palette

closestTailwindColor.description: Tailwind color whose curve the palette follows

code.description: The palette as code, ready to paste

inputShade.description: Shade that holds the input color unchanged, e.g. 500

replacesTailwindColor.description: True when the code replaces a default Tailwind palette (default color name, theme or config output)

title: Generate a Tailwind palette
